RULE	SETTING

Grace period
The whole window from the first failure to the point where the entry is flagged to a Tour Manager.
	7 days

Notification schedule
Notices go out at 24 hours, 3 days, 5 days and 7 days after the failure, asking the athlete to update their card. The same schedule drives insurance follow-up and recurring membership payments.
	24 hours · 3 days · 5 days · 7 days

Retry attempts
How many automatic attempts are made after the first failure. Zero means no automatic retry.
	2 attempts

1st retry
When the first automatic attempt runs after the failure.
	24 hours after the failure

2nd retry
The last automatic attempt. After this the entry needs a decision.
	3 days after the failure

Stop condition
Retries stop the moment the position is no longer available. Nothing is chased inside 10 days of the event: an entry still unpaid by then is flagged to a Tour Manager so an alternate has time to travel.
	Retries stop when the place is gone

Proceed without payment
Proceed without payment. A Tour Manager can clear an athlete to compete without paying, for a stated reason. Once set, the athlete is marked as a manual override and is never charged again for this event.
	Proceed without payment · Admin or Tour Manager · reason required · 10 in use this season
